title: Tech View groups work orders under each lead with name, avatar and count
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view (check in Settings > Roles & Permissions > open your role > Work Orders section). The Admin role has both.
  2. Use a desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  3. In the top bar, choose the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Create everything below in this location.
  4. Make sure the location has the technicians this case uses (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards" and "Jenny Wilson"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff record is Active, Clockable is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member > enter the first and last name (e.g. Esther Howard), role Technician, Clockable on, Active, enrolled at this location > Save.
  5. Create the work orders this case uses and set their lead technician (e.g. 3 led by Esther Howard (S1-702 Approved, S1-644 Approved, S1-455 Estimate), 2 led by Ralph Edwards, 1 with no lead):
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > choose the customer "ZZAUTOTEST Grouping" (add it with the Add button in the customer box if it does not exist; using it keeps this test's work orders apart from others at the location) and an asset (e.g. unit TRK-118, 2022 Freightliner M2) > Create. Write down the number the build gives the work order (the numbers in this case are examples).
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician (e.g. Esther Howard) and save. Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST Grouping so only this test's work orders show.
  4. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (in the design its tooltip reads "By Lead Tech").
  5. Look at how the table is divided.
  6. Read the header of Esther Howard's group: name, picture or initials, and number.
  7. Count the rows under Esther Howard.
  8. Open the Status filter, tick Approved only and close it.
  9. Read Esther Howard's header number and count her rows again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The table is split into groups, one per lead technician, with a visible separator line between groups.
  • Each group header shows the technician's name, their avatar (photo or initials) and a number.
  • The number equals the rows listed under it. Example: Esther Howard shows 3 with 3 rows (S1-702, S1-644, S1-455), Ralph Edwards shows 2 with 2 rows.
  • After filtering to Approved, Esther Howard's number becomes 2 and 2 rows are listed (S1-702, S1-644): 3 - 1 Estimate = 2.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10045 (Story 2, Tech View — table grouped by lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S2-R1, S2-R12, read 8 Oct 2026. Design: Claude Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html), By Lead Tech group header (count tooltip "N work orders"); on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “Group work orders by lead technician with visible separators.”
  • S2-R12: “Each group header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that group, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the rows listed.”
